author: Michael Larabel
description: MPV as the open-source, cross-platform media player originally based on MPlayer/mplayer2 is finally out with a new release...
title: MPV 0.42 Media Player Brings Wayland Improvements, Improved HDR

author: Michael Larabel
description: LXQt 2.5 released today as the newest feature update to this lightweight, Qt6-based desktop environment...
title: LXQt 2.5 Released With Enhanced QTerminal, Removing The Final LXDE Dependency

author: Michael Larabel
description: Along with today's release of the NVIDIA 620.70.06 Linux driver, NVIDIA also released CUDA 13.5 that brings general availability (GA) support for Vera Rubin...
title: NVIDIA CUDA 13.5 Released With Production Support For Vera Rubin

author: Michael Larabel
description: Back in 2023 Intel introduced One Mono as a new font for developers. Intel in September had discontinued the One Mono project but then days later revived it. Now the project is out with its first update since that mishap...
title: Intel One Mono Font Family Updated With Various Enhancements

author: Michael Larabel
description: Out today is the first NVIDIA Linux driver release in the R620 release branch. This NVIDIA 620.70.06 Linux driver release isn't too feature heavy but comes with some bug fixes, improved performance of explicit sync on Wayland, and some other refinements...
title: NVIDIA 620.70.06 Linux Driver Released With Wayland Fixes & Performance Work

author: Michael Larabel
description: A new vulnerability was disclosed today affecting Debian's APT package manager where a man-in-the-middle attacker could carry out arbitrary code execution as root...
title: Debian's APT Affected By Man-In-The-Middle Attack For Arbitrary Code Execution As Root

author: Michael Larabel
description: While the Linux 7.4 kernel will be released in the 2026 calendar year in the last week or two of December if the schedule holds, it turns out Linux 7.3 is likely to be this year's Long Term Support kernel version...
title: Linux 7.3 Will More Than Likely Be This Year's LTS Kernel

author: Michael Larabel
description: Systemd recently merged support for Rust programs. This initial systemd Rust support is limited to leaf components / individual binaries while eventually they hope to be able to support Rust within root components of systemd. More details on this initiative were shared this week...
title: systemd With Its Initial Support For Rust

author: Michael Larabel
description: From earlier in the year you may recall a new experimental open-source Linux driver for modern DisplayLink hardware. That "Vino" driver for DisplayLink driver was a clean-room reverse-engineered DisplayLink driver that was developed in part by AI and written in Rust. Unfortunately, that open-source driver has disappeared following legal threats by Synaptics...
title: Synaptics Appears To Use Legal Threats To Block Open-Source DisplayLink Driver

author: Michael Larabel
description: In addition to organizations like Alibaba, SpaceXSI, DigitalOcean, Meta SuperIntelligence Labs, and others contributing millions of dollars toward the development of the Omarchy Linux distribution, it turns out AMD also has a thing for this Linux distribution built around the Hyprland compositor...
title: "AMD Loves Omarchy" Linux With More Collaboration Coming

author: Michael Larabel
description: Last month I wrote about Intel working on adding proper XeSS support to Steam Play (Proton). While those efforts haven't yet been completed for benefiting Linux gamers running Intel Arc Graphics, in the meantime an independent open-source developer has managed to get XMX-accelerated XeSS working under Proton...
title: Experimental Project Gets Intel XeSS On XMX Working With Valve's Steam Play (Proton)

author: Michael Larabel
description: Last month Intel and AMD jointly announced they would be collaborating on software optimizations with PyTorch/oneDNN. That already led to the UXL Foundation's release of oneDNN 3.14 with initial AMD Zen optimizations. It looks though like for now at least AMD will also continue to concurrently push new work into their ZenDNN library and not exclusively tied to oneDNN. Out today is ZenDNN 6.1...
title: AMD Releases ZenDNN 6.1 With New Kernels & Optimizations
